productName: OmniClip — 100% Local AI Video Repurposing & Viral 9:16 Shorts Studio

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of repurposing long-form videos into captioned vertical shorts getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With OmniClip, Word-Level Transcript Trimming & Hook Detection runs right where you already work. Automatic 9:16 Active-Speaker Face Reframing and Burned-In Kinetic Captions & WebVTT Export—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle repurposing long-form videos into captioned vertical shorts, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch OmniClip in action: Edit video as easily as editing text—click start and end words in the local transcript to cut tight vertical clips in seconds. On-device computer vision keeps the speaking host centered smoothly in a 9:16 vertical frame without manual keyframing in a timeline. Plus, generate high-contrast animated word captions and matching .vtt subtitle files automatically from your local audio track. Raw 4K footage, client depositions, and embargoed interviews never leave your hard drive—zero upload queues and zero per-minute cloud credits. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
